verdict_reason: the repro test still fails with the PR applied
claim: Transliterates accented letters to their ASCII equivalents in slugify.
summary: The PR attempts to fix accented letter handling but uses a regex that drops non-ASCII characters entirely instead of transliterating them to ASCII equivalents. The test evidence confirms the fix doesn't work (still failing).

findings.rule: Fixes the root cause described in the spec, not just the symptom
findings.note: The regex `[^\x00-\x7f]` drops all non-ASCII characters (including accented letters) instead of transliterating them to ASCII equivalents (e.g., é→e, û→u). The spec requires 'creme-brulee' but this produces 'cr-me-br-l-e'.

findings.rule: Handles the edge cases the spec mentions
findings.note: The spec explicitly mentions 'Crème Brûlée' and 'Café au lait' as test cases. The current implementation fails both because it removes accented letters rather than converting them.
